//: Precondition digest for apply_surface_transaction (expectedSha256): SHA-256 of the file text as the webview reads it. Bytes -> strip one leading UTF-8 BOM -> decode UTF-8 replacing each maximal invalid subpart with U+FFFD (WHATWG TextDecoder, Rust String::from_utf8_lossy) -> re-encode UTF-8 -> SHA-256, lowercase hex. Checked by surface_write.rs tests (Rust rule) and McpServersPage tests (webview side).

cases.name: bom
cases.note: UTF-8 byte-order mark: TextDecoder drops it

cases.name: invalid-utf8
cases.note: lone continuation-less lead byte (C3 28), a byte that never appears in UTF-8 (FF), and a three-byte sequence cut short (E2 82) inside a JSON string

cases.name: truncated-at-end
cases.note: four-byte sequence cut short by end of file (F0 9F 98)

cases.name: surrogate-and-overlong
cases.note: encoded surrogate (ED A0 80) and overlong forms (C0 AF, E0 80 AF): one U+FFFD per byte

cases.name: bom-twice
cases.note: only the first BOM is dropped; the second decodes to U+FEFF
